issues.explanation: This compositional noun should be split into dictionary words 金縁 and 眼鏡.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 金縁 / 眼鏡 as separate word segments.

issues.explanation: 寒鴉 is read かんがらす, not かんあ.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to かんがらす.

issues.explanation: 特別 itself means “special” or “particular”; the adverbial meaning “particularly” arises with に.
In 写生し始めた, 始める functions as an auxiliary expressing beginning an action.
描か is the irrealis stem of 描く; the passive meaning is supplied by れ, so it should not mean “be drawn” by itself.
The grammar overlay for そのまま labels a lexical adverbial expression, not a grammatical construction spanning multiple elements.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove this grammar overlay; retain the word annotation.
